scripts.//config: Four keys, not Helios's or Iris's five. Atlas has no text call, so there is deliberately no text_model — a config key with no reader is one somebody will eventually set and wonder why nothing changed. See atlas-02 decision 7.
scripts.config:pull: for k in image_model max_retries retention_limit max_resume_attempts; do v=$(wrangler kv key get --binding CONFIG --remote "$k") && wrangler kv key put --binding CONFIG --local "$k" "$v"; done
scripts.//kv: Always reach local KV through these. Bare wrangler run from the repo root finds no wrangler.jsonc, silently leaves this app's KV untouched, and the next request quietly uses the old value, so you conclude the config system is broken when it is working perfectly. npm runs a script with its own package as the working directory, so these cannot land in the wrong place.
